description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the LeavePeriodDao in the OrangeHRM HRM system. It contains test cases for saving leave period history, retrieving current leave period, and handling leave entitlement changes upon leave period updates.

classes.name: LeavePeriodDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class testing the LeavePeriodDao methods related to leave period history management, retrieval, and entitlement adjustments

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mock data and sets up test environment before each test

methods.name: testSaveLeavePeriodHistoryFirstTime
methods.description: Tests saving a new leave period history when no existing period is present

methods.name: testSaveLeavePeriodHistory
methods.description: Tests updating leave period history and verifying leave entitlement adjustments

methods.name: testSaveLeavePeriodHistoryWithTransactionException
methods.description: Ensures proper transaction rollback when an exception occurs during leave period history save

methods.name: testGetCurrentLeavePeriodStartDateAndMonth
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of the current leave period start date and month

methods.name: testGetLeavePeriodHistoryList
methods.description: Checks retrieval of the list of leave period histories

methods.name: testEntitlementChangeWhenLeavePeriodChanged
methods.description: Simulates a leave period change and verifies that leave entitlements are correctly adjusted for employees
